query:
CREATE TABLE `chats` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`userId` int NOT NULL,
	`title` varchar(500),
	`projectId` int,
	`selectedModels` json DEFAULT ('[]'),
	`selectedSources` json DEFAULT ('[]'),
	`createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	`updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
	CONSTRAINT `chats_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);
CREATE TABLE `feedback` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`userId` int NOT NULL,
	`chatId` int,
	`rating` int,
	`comment` longtext,
	`feedbackType` varchar(50),
	`createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	CONSTRAINT `feedback_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);
CREATE TABLE `messages` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`chatId` int NOT NULL,
	`role` enum('user','assistant','system') NOT NULL,
	`content` longtext NOT NULL,
	`attachments` json DEFAULT ('[]'),
	`modelUsed` varchar(255),
	`createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	CONSTRAINT `messages_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);
CREATE TABLE `modelEvaluations` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`chatId` int NOT NULL,
	`messageId` int NOT NULL,
	`model` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
	`evaluationScore` decimal(5,2),
	`qualityMetrics` json DEFAULT ('{}'),
	`evaluationDetails` longtext,
	`createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	CONSTRAINT `modelEvaluations_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);
CREATE TABLE `papers` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`userId` int NOT NULL,
	`title` varchar(1000) NOT NULL,
	`authors` text,
	`abstract` longtext,
	`url` varchar(2000),
	`storageKey` varchar(500),
	`source` varchar(100),
	`externalId` varchar(255),
	`createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	CONSTRAINT `papers_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);
CREATE TABLE `projects` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`userId` int NOT NULL,
	`name` varchar(500) NOT NULL,
	`description` text,
	`color` varchar(7),
	`createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	`updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
	CONSTRAINT `projects_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);
CREATE TABLE `reports` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`userId` int NOT NULL,
	`chatId` int,
	`title` varchar(500) NOT NULL,
	`storageKey` varchar(500) NOT NULL,
	`paperIds` json DEFAULT ('[]'),
	`summary` longtext,
	`createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	CONSTRAINT `reports_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);
CREATE TABLE `searchHistory` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`userId` int NOT NULL,
	`query` varchar(1000) NOT NULL,
	`sources` json DEFAULT ('[]'),
	`resultsCount` int,
	`createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	CONSTRAINT `searchHistory_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);
CREATE TABLE `userSettings` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`userId` int NOT NULL,
	`notificationsEnabled` boolean DEFAULT true,
	`emailNotifications` boolean DEFAULT false,
	`defaultModel` varchar(255) DEFAULT 'gpt-4',
	`defaultSources` json DEFAULT ('["arxiv","pubmed"]'),
	`autoSaveChats` boolean DEFAULT true,
	`createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	`updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
	CONSTRAINT `userSettings_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`),
	CONSTRAINT `userSettings_userId_unique` UNIQUE(`userId`)
);
ALTER TABLE `users` ADD `username` varchar(255);
ALTER TABLE `users` ADD `themePreference` enum('light','dark','system') DEFAULT 'system' NOT NULL;
ALTER TABLE `users` ADD CONSTRAINT `users_username_unique` UNIQUE(`username`);
ALTER TABLE `users` ADD CONSTRAINT `users_email_unique` UNIQUE(`email`);
